title: EgoHandWAM: Probing the Role of Hand Motion in Egocentric World Action Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.22151v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How much does hand motion tell us about what a first-person camera will see next? EgoHandWAM forecasts three-dimensional wrist and fingertip trajectories and a future visual feature from the current image and recent hand states. We train on 751,065 EgoDex windows using a frozen DINOv2 encoder. On held-out development sessions, the action-only model reduces two-second wrist endpoint error from 60.26 to 56.48~mm relative to a stationary forecast. It still underestimates long reaches. Adding future-feature supervision gives nearly identical trajectory accuracy. With the recorded hand history, the visual head reduces smooth L1 error by 1.32\% relative to copying the current feature. Shuffling histories across sessions erases this gain. In a separate four-task probe, adding recorded future displacements to observed context and future tracking-validity masks reduces visual-feature error by 3.93\%. Masks alone give little improvement. translated_title: EgoHandWAM：探究手部运动在第一人称世界动作建模中的作用
translated_abstract: 手部运动能在多大程度上告诉我们第一人称相机接下来会看到什么？EgoHandWAM 从当前图像和近期手部状态预测三维手腕和指尖轨迹以及未来视觉特征。我们使用冻结的 DINOv2 编码器在 751,065 个 EgoDex 窗口上进行训练。在留出的开发会话上，仅动作模型相对于静止预测将两秒手腕端点误差从 60.26 毫米降至 56.48 毫米，但该模型仍会低估长距离伸展动作。添加未来特征监督只能得到几乎相同的轨迹精度。利用记录的手部历史，视觉预测头相对于直接复制当前特征可将平滑 L1 误差降低 1.32%；而跨会话打乱手部历史则会完全消除这一增益。在一个独立的四任务探测实验中，将记录的未来位移添加到观察上下文和未来跟踪有效性掩码中，可使视觉特征误差降低 3.93%，而仅使用掩码几乎没有改进。
tldr: EgoHandWAM 通过在 75 万余个第一人称操作片段上联合预测三维手部轨迹和未来视觉特征，实验表明手部运动信息对未来视觉预测仅有有限提升（约1-4%的误差降低），揭示了手部运动在第一人称世界建模中作用的边界。
en_tdlr: EgoHandWAM jointly forecasts 3D hand trajectories and future visual features on 750K+ egocentric manipulation windows, showing that hand motion provides only modest (1-4%) gains for future visual prediction, probing the limits of hand motion's role in egocentric world modeling.
